---
# agd-v2/fleet-hub-lab/prod.yaml
__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: "Fleet Hub Lab (ACM hub + three spokes)"
  deployer:
    type: agnosticd
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main
  sandbox_api:
    pool: aws-shared-pool-b

cloud_provider: aws
aws_region: us-east-2
# one VPC for the hub cluster and one per spoke
fleet_hub_spoke_count: 3

# 2026-07-02: destroys kept hanging for an hour on ENI cleanup. Tolerate VPC
# delete failures so the destroy finishes; the sandbox reaper is meant to catch
# stragglers.
aws_vpc_teardown_tolerate_errors: true

ocp4_workload_ecr_pull_through_enable: true
